mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances that may impair atomoxetine metabolism and clearance, while atomoxetine's sympathomimetic effects may exacerbate amphotericin B-induced cardiac dysrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac status closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust atomoxetine dosing based on renal function changes.
